data.one_liner: Highly customizable, feature-packed calendar widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable calendar widget supporting month, two-week, and week formats. Allows range or multiple selection, event loaders, locale configuration, and custom builders for UI design.
use_when: You need to display a monthly, weekly, or bi-weekly calendar in your Flutter app.
Users need to select single dates, date ranges, or multiple dates.
You want to display dynamic events or holidays tied to specific calendar days.
avoid_when: You require an event scheduling grid with hourly or minute-based time slots (it is date-based).
You need a minimal date picker dialog rather than a full calendar view.
strengths: Extensive customization options including custom builders and styling.
Supports locale configuration with date formatting.
Built-in support for range and multiple date selection.
weaknesses: Requires manual initialization of date formatting using the intl package for locales.
Does not include an out-of-the-box hourly time-slot view.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding table_calendar to pubspec.yaml. For locale support, intl and initializeDateFormatting must be configured in main().
data.minimal_example:
TableCalendar(
  firstDay: DateTime.utc(2010, 10, 16),
  lastDay: DateTime.utc(2030, 3, 14),
  focusedDay: DateTime.now(),
)
